strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.subtitle: Choose how to select among multiple enabled global configs, and how failures are handled.
strategy.multiModelNote: When multiple global configs are enabled (by order), the following applies:
strategy.failureBehaviorFirst: First: Always use the first active config (lowest order). If that call fails, the request fails immediately — no automatic fallback to the next config.
strategy.failureBehaviorRoundRobin: Round-robin: Each new request uses the next config in order. If a call fails, that request fails; the next request will use the next config in the rotation.

wizard.contextHint: Write what the model cannot infer from reading code alone: business background, team conventions, search priorities, and directories to avoid.
wizard.contextPlaceholder:
# Information the model can't know just from reading code — write it here.

## Project overview
# SourceLens is a self-hosted AI code Q&A platform.
# backend/ is the Django REST API; lensnode/ is a separately deployed execution node
# that runs Deep Agents and pushes results back to the main service via WebSocket.
# frontend/ is the Vue 3 admin console; it only talks to backend/ REST APIs.

## Search priorities
# Business logic lives in backend/lens/. backend/agentcore/ is a git submodule — don't look for business code there.
# Frontend pages: frontend/src/pages/lens/. Admin components: frontend/src/admin/.
# Agent behavior: lensnode/lensnode/agent_runtime.py.

## Avoid misreading
# references/ contains reference documents, not source code — don't analyze it as code.
# For current field structure, read the latest migration only, not historical ones.
